integrity: The universal claim is proved analytically. Exhaustive finite enumeration through order six is used only as a stress test. Literature noncoverage is based on the explicitly checked sources and searches, with residual terminology risk stated in the review.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to complete multipartite graphs with at least three parts and exactly the chromatic number of available colours. It does not solve the larger-palette case.
title: Forced colourings of complete multipartite graphs at the chromatic palette size
